seats.notes: Red-white aggro with fliers and removal: Rebuke x2, Brimstone Volley, Bonds of Faith, Dearly Departed and Abbey Griffin as evasion, plus cheap bodies. Cut Traveler's Amulet, Rage Thrower, Vampiric Fury and the other off-plan cards; 23 spells with 9 Mountain and 8 Plains.

Black is the deep color, so I'm building black with a light red splash for Geistflame, Bloodcrazed Neonate and Riot Devils. The deck is cheap creatures, Bloodline Keeper, Victim of Night and Tribute to Hunger for removal, with 17 lands (11 Swamp, 6 Mountain).

Blue is too thin (about 9 playables, mostly weak) and the green pool is deep enough for 23 playables, so I'm going mono-green with the two colourless equipment. Blazing Torch and the Prey Upon/Spidery Grasp removal suite carry the deck, and Spider Spawning gives late-game value.

…fliers and tempo: Victim of Night, Claustrophobia, Reaper from the Abyss and Stitched Drake/Moon Heron carry the deck, with Selhoff Occultist and Stitcher's Apprentice for early plays. Cut Dissipate, Fortress Crab, the second Lost in the Mist and the weaker black sorceries to keep the curve low.

…white and 9 red playables: fliers (Abbey Griffin, Chapel Geist, Voiceless Spirit x2, Spectral Rider), removal (Harvest Pyre, Into the Maw of Hell, Rally, Furor), and cheap bodies. Paraselene and the Vampire-only cards are cut to the sideboard, and Rage Thrower and Crossway Vampire fill the curve.

…deck: 12 creatures, cheap removal (Smite, Fiend Hunter, Urgent Exorcism, Devil's Play, Rolling Temblor), and Moment of Heroism tricks. Cut Burning Vengeance, Spare from Evil, Cobbled Wings, Demonmail Hauberk and Witchbane Orb; 17 lands with a 9/8 Plains/Mountain split for white's heavier costs.

Blue-black: removal (Dead Weight x2, Victim of Night, Grasp, Silent Departure, Torch) plus fliers (Stitched Drake, Moon Heron, Lantern Spirit, Interloper) and Moan for value. Cut the red and green cards and the weaker Curses and Rooftop Storm; 17 lands, nine Islands for the blue-heavy top end.

…is the deepest colour, and Garruk Relentless makes green the clear second colour, so this is a W/G deck with a creature-heavy curve plus removal (Fiend Hunter, Smite) and equipment. I cut the blue and black cards and the weaker red and black fillers, and ran 10 Plains and 7 Forest for 17 lands.

reask_reasons.thought: Opp is at 1. Chant returns Falkenrath Noble, which I can cast this main phase. Then if Ghoul attacks and Sentry blocks, Sentry dying triggers Noble's drain for the win; if unblocked, the 3 damage is lethal.
